commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+9' West Ham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+9' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+9' Callum Wilson (West Ham) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Matz Sels.
90+7' A cross by El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90+6' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 30215.

90+1' 0 - 3 Goal – 0:3! El Hadji Malick Diouf sends a superb cross into the box. Callum Wilson (West Ham) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header into the top right corner, leaving Matz Sels beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish.
90+1' A cross from a corner kick by Nottingham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.

70' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take the corner.

68' Callum Wilson (West Ham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Matz Sels has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Chris Wood (Nottingham) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!

39' Matz Sels pulls off a great save to deny Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
